sheet.div: How to build a dashboard: 1) Set Dashboard and Menu (host model, menu entry). 2) Configure Configuration (scopes, graph, filters — same as the live Configuration popup). 3) Compose Card layout (header, primary action, KPIs, bottom buttons). 4) Fill Manage menu (Views / New / Reports — same as the live card menu). 5) Publish — a menu appears under the parent you chose.
This dashboard is live. Open it from the menu you configured, or use Check References after installing / removing apps.
This dashboard points at things that are no longer installed:
